# e57view

Browser viewer for E57 / PLY / LAS point clouds. Humans open a scan; agents drive it.

## Open a scan

https://opensketch.web.app/?cloud=CLOUD_ID
https://opensketch.web.app/?cloud=CLOUD_ID&view=top
https://opensketch.web.app/?cloud=CLOUD_ID&view=fit&ai=heuristic&kinds=noise

Query args: cloud, view (fit|top), az, el, dist, ai (heuristic|openai|xai), kinds (comma list:
veg,vehicle,people,noise), session, agent=1 (local MCP bridge).

## Drive a viewer tab over HTTP (no MCP)

1. In the viewer: Agent -> Copy agent URL. That copies a page link and a bearer token.
   The token is shown once and never appears in the URL. Keep the tab open.
2. POST https://opensketch.web.app/agent with the token in an Authorization header:

curl -s https://opensketch.web.app/agent \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"session":"SESSION","cmd":"state"}'

Commands: state, screenshot, set_view, set, regions, pick, measure, ai_suggest,
suggestions, history, stations, open.

{"session":"S","cmd":"screenshot","args":{"width":1024}}
{"session":"S","cmd":"set_view","args":{"preset":"top"}}
{"session":"S","cmd":"set_view","args":{"pose":{"p":[10,10,5],"t":[0,0,0]}}}
{"session":"S","cmd":"ai_suggest","args":{"provider":"heuristic","kinds":["noise"]}}
{"session":"S","cmd":"suggestions","args":{"op":"apply"}}
{"session":"S","cmd":"history","args":{"op":"undo"}}

GET /agent                     command list
GET /agent?s=SESSION           session status (token required)

Responses carry result JSON and, for most commands, shot (JPEG base64).

## Limits

- The session id is a name, not a credential. Without the token every request is 401.
- Sessions expire 8 hours after they are created. Stop session revokes one immediately.
- Sessions are read-only by default. Commands that drop points, write a file, load another
  scan or call a paid model (regions/suggestions apply, history undo|redo|save, open,
  ai_suggest with openai or xai) return 403 until the viewer tab ticks Allow edits.
- The original file on disk is never overwritten.

## Local MCP (agent on the same machine as the tab)

claude mcp add e57view -- node /path/to/e57view/mcp/server.mjs
Then open the viewer with ?agent=1

MCP needs no network exposure and is the safer choice when the agent runs beside the browser.
